claims.claim: TSMC is a central manufacturing bottleneck linking AI compute demand to advanced-node wafers and advanced packaging; Q2 2026 revenue was US$40.20B with 67.7% gross margin, and Q3 guidance rose to US$44.6-45.8B.
Current demand remains structurally strong beyond one quarter: January-August 2026 revenue reached NT$3.387T, up 39.3% year over year.

CoWoS remains the majority advanced-packaging path today, while management is developing lower-cost alternatives and substrate-vendor solutions; this makes successor-bottleneck evolution explicit rather than assuming permanent CoWoS exclusivity.

falsifiers: Sustained AI semiconductor growth without TSMC advanced-node/packaging participation would weaken bottleneck-control thesis.
A credible competing foundry achieving comparable yield/economics at leading nodes would weaken substitution resilience.
Persistent overseas-fab cost dilution without pricing/productivity offsets would weaken scenario robustness.

risks.risk: Geopolitical Taiwan concentration remains a structural tail risk even as overseas capacity expands.
Very high capex and overseas expansion can pressure returns if demand utilization normalizes sharply.

unknowns.unknown: This Beta object does not quantify customer-by-customer concentration or overseas-fab margin dilution.

claims.claim: Current operating evidence falsifies a near-term demand-collapse thesis: Q2 revenue exceeded the high end of guidance and August monthly revenue was up 53.3% year over year.
The strongest red-team pressure is capital intensity/geopolitical concentration and the risk of extrapolating extraordinary AI demand, not a present liquidity or execution failure evidenced here.
Management expects significantly higher capex over the next three years than the prior three-year US$101B total, increasing the penalty if utilization, pricing or technology leadership disappoints.

risks.risk: Large forward capex raises downside sensitivity to utilization and pricing.
Taiwan concentration remains a low-frequency/high-severity operational risk.

unknowns.unknown: No independent valuation/crowding input is asserted in this Beta object.
No present accounting-quality defect is evidenced here.
